## Summary

Provide a concise explanation of what changes this PR introduces and why they are necessary.

Fixes #(issue number if applicable)

---

## Type of Change

- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] `feat`: New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] `refactor`: Code restructuring without functional behavior change
- [ ] `perf`: Performance enhancement
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation improvement
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, workflow, or dependency update

---

## Verification & Testing

Describe how the changes were verified:
- [ ] Relevant unit / integration tests added or executed
- [ ] Linter / static analysis passed (e.g. `cargo clippy`, `ruff`, `eslint`)
- [ ] Manual verification completed on local target OS (e.g., Windows 11)

---

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and principles of this project (Local-first, clean boundaries).
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / README where relevant.
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] No private keys, sensitive paths, or personal tokens are included.
